descriptionChirho: Adversative-asseverative conjunction introducing a contrasting or emphatic statement, rendered 'but indeed' or 'and surely.' English 'and–but / but–indeed,' Spanish 'Y–ciertamente / Pero–ciertamente,' Hindi 'परन्तु / लेकिन,' Arabic 'وَلكِنْ / وَإلّا,' Korean '그러나 / 그러나–참으로,' Swahili 'lakini / na–hata–hivyo.' Both clusters show the same adversative force with asseverative overtone, differing only in frequency (18x vs 1x) and minor tagging variation.
